description: NaCa₂Ta₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4m2 space group. Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. Ca is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-3.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.31 Å. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ta-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ta atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Ca and two Ta atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Ta atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Ta atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Ca and two equivalent Ta atoms.
